ruling: SBL consumes nothing of the Fabric governance contract, it only cites it, and it was not upgraded on the current HG-KSEOS base (18 commits / 278 paths behind, with a vacuous compatibility pin and an uninstalled hg_kseos dependency). The measured degradation of SBL & HG-KSEOS versus HG-KSEOS alone is an acceptance-throughput and declaration-versus-implementation deficit; a material time or money premium is NOT supported by the artefacts and is not claimed. None of the seven capability surfaces supports the owner's full 'all-on with automated self-detect / self-repair / self-accept' requirement. This is a CANDIDATE research product, not an acceptance.

declared_vs_pinned_deviation.why_permitted: The pool's own selection_semantics permits it: 'the instructed entry replaces rank 1' (ResearchRequest.yaml:43-47). The declared rank-1 arms for PLAN and VERIFY_SECURITY are openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol (evidence/W3_capability_probe.md:307, :963).
declared_vs_pinned_deviation.effect_on_claims: Lane arm choice does not change any measured capability state, root cause, or claim ceiling in this verdict. It is disclosed as a deviation from the pool's declared rank-1, not a silent substitution.
declared_vs_pinned_deviation.receipt_ceiling: Both receipts bind required == served, exit 0, nonce present and usage receipt true. credential_posture is INCONCLUSIVE / WARN_CONTINUE and subject_mutation is not_guarded. These are not acceptance receipts and prove neither native execution authority nor subject verification (evidence/W3_capability_probe.md:594).

Q1.question: Does SBL CONSUME the Fabric governance contract, or only CITE it?
Q1.answer: Only CITE it. SBL does not fully or correctly integrate into the Fabric governance contract.
counter_evidence_preserved: Genuine HGK construction WorkOrders exist (CREATED / FAILED / ROLLED_BACK history) including this round's WO-TS-REQ-HGK-PRJ-SBL-HGK-RCA-20261022-EXEC; that is real admission history, not an SBL runtime WorkOrder -> ExecutionBinding -> Permit consumer chain.
SBL's own local refusals (same maker/checker, SUMMARY_ONLY, raised ceiling, provider off) are real local invariants, not authenticated native-principal proof.
No SBL-native WorkOrder or Permit minting implementation was observed, and this round invoked no issuance or mutation API.

Q2.question: Was SBL built/upgraded on the current HG-KSEOS base (3dfaebc / pool rev 18), and how large is the drift?
Q2.answer: No. SBL is 18 commits and 278 changed paths behind a base it names as current; its compatibility gate is structurally blind to that distance; its declared hg_kseos dependency is not installed in the interpreter it records; and its own handover states no conformance measurement exists after b22706e.

Q2.not_a_fork_and_not_a_stale_root: adapter hgk_root resolves to the live HG-KSEOS tree with 0 commits of resolved-root drift; no vendored hg_kseos fork exists in SBL.

Q3.question: Where does the measured performance delta come from (gates, duplicated planes, SoD collision, backlog)?
Q3.answer: From three nameable mechanisms, not from time or money: (1) contract discontinuity - SBL consumes no Fabric contract and has no native WorkOrder -> ExecutionBinding -> Permit consumer, so it stacks an unprovable plane above HG-KSEOS; (2) the acceptance gate versus the self-accept label - every round settles on independent acceptance, SBL's own label is self-accept, and HGK forbids writer == checker, so acceptance must be sourced externally and 3/3 primary rounds did not obtain it; (3) declaration/implementation separation - the drift gate compares each surface to the file it points at and never two surfaces to each other. A material time or money premium is NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_ARTEFACTS.

Q4.question: Which of the seven capability surfaces are actually enabled today, measured, not declared?
Q4.answer: No. 'SBL & HG-KSEOS' cannot today enable KANBAN / SWARM / GSTACK / OPENSPEC with CODEX CLI plus multiple SUB-AGENTs in parallel, complete the task, and run automated self-detect / self-repair / self-accept, let alone governed self-research / self-learning / self-iteration / self-evolution. Only SWARM (graph presence only), CODEX CLI (receipt scope only) and self-detect exist at all; KANBAN, GSTACK and SUB-AGENTS are PARTIAL; OPENSPEC, self-accept and self-evolve are FAIL.
Q4.no_upgrade_no_softening: No PARTIAL was raised to PASS and no FAIL was softened. W3's rule applies verbatim: PASS never implies product acceptance; PARTIAL means a measured working subset; OpenSpec failure and autonomous self-accept failure remain FAIL (evidence/W3_capability_probe.md:21).

structural.cause: The compatibility version pin is vacuous: >=0.1.0,<0.2.0 against a package whose version has not moved in 147 of 148 commits is a constant, not a drift gate.
structural.lever: Bind the adapter pin to an HG-KSEOS commit SHA and make a mismatch fail instead of reporting observed_version.

structural.cause: The declared hg_kseos dependency is neither installed nor wired, so requires_native [WorkOrder, ExecutionBinding, Permit] is declaration only.
structural.lever: Declare the dependency in pyproject and make the recorded host.executable able to import hg_kseos, in two separable phases.

structural.cause: The Fabric governance contract is not consumed: schema, registration and evidence-packet seams are all ABSENT.
structural.lever: Obtain the contract owner's applicability ruling, bind the ABI version/digest, and demonstrate a real refusal on a nonconforming input.

structural.cause: The self-accept label collides with the SoD invariant: same maker/checker is refused by both SBL M05 and HGK spine.
structural.lever: Split the vocabulary into self-detect / self-repair / independent-accept and let the dispatcher refuse writer == checker directly.

structural.cause: Self-repair and self-evolution have producers but no executing consumers; the evolution ledger is not a self-applying gate.
structural.lever: Attach a governed consumer to the repair plan and the evolution delta and make both mandatory call points.

structural.cause: The drift gate is structurally blind: it compares each pin to the file it points at and never two surfaces to each other.
structural.lever: Add a surface-to-surface agreement gate over the governed PLAN plane, the EXECUTE lane declaration and provider_route versus the pool rank-1.

process.cause: Acceptance throughput deficit: 3/3 primary SBL rounds recorded FAILED workorders and FAIL acceptance.
process.lever: Make obtaining the first independent verdict a hard gate condition of a round.

process.cause: The base is stale and unmeasured: 18 commits / 278 paths behind, conformance last measured before b22706e.
process.lever: Re-measure conformance on the absolute and same baseline first, then rebind.

process.cause: Backlog is not drained: ready kanban cards, handover open items and a large frozen scope ledger remain OPEN.
process.lever: Schedule by backlog unit and give every one of the 38 surfaces an explicit closure condition.

process.cause: Delegation persistence is incomplete: only 3 of 4 worker raw outputs landed.
process.lever: Make worker raw-output landing plus sha256 readback a completion condition of dispatch.

process.cause: self_check_r* has no mandatory production caller.
process.lever: Wire it into an existing fail-closed gate path.

process.cause: Declaration surfaces disagree with each other: assignment epoch 29 versus registry epoch 30, and the governed PLAN plane and provider_route versus the pool rank-1.
process.lever: Make epoch and pool the single source of truth across surfaces and assert agreement before any write.

process.cause: Read-only audit scope limits several surfaces to existence rather than execution.
process.lever: Re-test SWARM dispatch and GSTACK named-method execution in an explicitly authorised mutation-free sandbox.

declarative.cause: SBL's own ceiling is STANDALONE_ONLY, which is materially narrower than the owner's expected full integration with self-acceptance.
declarative.lever: Publish a single owner-expectation versus declared-ceiling versus measured table so the gap is visible at the declaration layer.

declarative.cause: The candidate R9 contract and contracts/compiled-r9/ are untracked and were inspected as candidate evidence, not committed source.
declarative.lever: Either bring them under version control as a comparable baseline, or mark every claim that cites them as untracked-candidate.

declarative.cause: Fabric is described narrowly as 'the autonomous-research harness' rather than as the governance / assurance / interop / knowledge contract surface.
declarative.lever: Align the wording with the operative projection so no waiver of contract consumption is derived from a narrow description.

declarative.cause: Two OPENSPEC changes are declared but carry no spec delta, so openspec validate --all is a hard failure.
declarative.lever: Add deltas or set skip_specs: true as the tool's own message prescribes, without touching the SoD refusal semantics.

declarative.cause: The version declaration has not moved: pyproject 0.1.0 fixed at ec58a0b while the release tree is 0.1.1rc1 and the install ships only a pointer.
declarative.lever: Design any version bump together with a failable base pin, otherwise a bump changes no compatibility fact.

declarative.cause: The term 'self-accept' carries two meanings at once: a capability name and the behaviour HG-KSEOS forbids.
declarative.lever: Split the term into three separately measurable capabilities across all governance documents.

claim_ceiling: CANDIDATE_ONLY research product. Not an acceptance, not native integration, not a host installation, not a promotion, not a full-contract closure, no completion percentage, and no claimed time or money premium for SBL & HG-KSEOS versus HG-KSEOS alone. HGK acceptance for this round stays NOT_RUN. This verdict is a research product; the owner has granted no acceptance.
next_best_action: Ask the Fabric contract owner for the applicability ruling on SBL as a governed surface (this is the seam that decides whether SBL can ever consume the contract), then re-measure HG-KSEOS conformance on the absolute and same baseline at the current base 3dfaebc as the first action because it gates every other claim, and then obtain the first independent verdict from a VERIFY_SECURITY lane that did not make the work.
